'''Gheedor Sornell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who joined the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==Biography==
As a child during the war, he spent his time in the war alongside his [[Parent/Legends|parents]]: [[Koblus Sornell]] and [[Haarm Sornell]].
